neighbours.label: the token '-sided' (one-sided, double-sided); also fires on ' Valley' in 'Mill Valley'
fire: The debate was a rather two-sided affair with no clear winner.
The children cut a six-sided shape out of coloured card.
Critics called the documentary a three-sided portrait of the city.
He kept a single-sided copy of the contract in the drawer.
It was a many-sided problem that no committee could solve.
The match ended in a lop-sided victory for the visitors.
Use double-sided tape to fix the mirror to the wall.
The treaty was a hopelessly one-sided bargain for the islanders.
quiet: The debate was a rather two-way affair with no clear winner.
The children cut a six-pointed shape out of coloured card.
Critics called the documentary a three-part portrait of the city.
He kept a single-page copy of the contract in the drawer.
It was a problem with many sides that no committee could solve.
The match ended in a one-handed catch by the visitors.
Use both sides of the tape to fix the mirror to the wall.
The treaty was a hopelessly unfair bargain for the islanders.

notes: Card: '-sided' x9, ' Valley' x6 (Mill Valley). Probes: one-sided 0.93, double-sided 0.48, Mill Valley 0.79, Death Valley 0.11. Only '-sided' is tested.
